extraction.Name: David Guerue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 23, 1918 by the Bank of Crookston
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged for $800.00; conveyed to Frank Yancey for $1400.00, subject to the foregoing mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612681 issued; northeast quarter of Section 8, township 35, range 32; receipt for patent signed but not dated; on May 7, 1917, Guerue mortgaged the land for $800.00; on May 11, 1918 he and his wife conveyed the same to Frank Yancey for $1400.00 subject to the foregoing mortgage
